paper_metadata.title: Effect of niobium content on the precipitation behavior and mechanical properties of Ni-Cr alloys

evidence.quote: The effect of niobium content on the precipitation behavior and mechanical properties of Ni-Cr alloys, both in as-deposited and heat-treated states, was investigated.
To compare the differences in precipitates in Ni-Cr alloys before and after heat treatment
In this study, two types of Ni-Cr alloys with varying Nb contents were prepared using ERNiCr-3 wire as the raw material and the GTAW welding method.
Ultimately, two nickel-based alloys with varying Nb contents were produced, designated as Nb-L and Nb-H, with their chemical compositions detailed in Table 1.
